result.instructions: Tools for Shoprocket, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are paid but not yet shipped?"; "How did my store do last week compared with the week before?"; "Which products have a stock quantity under 5?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shoprocket data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shoprocket_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shoprocket_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shoprocket_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. shoprocket_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_store
tools.title: Get store
tools.description: The Shoprocket store this key belongs to: name, address, environment (test or live), paused state, currencies and languages, setup status. The store's API keys are never returned. GET /v1/store/details.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_store_stats
tools.title: Get store stats
tools.description: Sales statistics for a date range, compared with the previous period: orders, revenue, visitors, abandoned carts, conversion rate, average order value, a daily sales graph, regions, sources and popular products. GET /v1/store/stats.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List or search orders with totals, customer, addresses, payment and fulfillment status, discounts, line items and shipping. Filter by payment status, fulfillment status, payment method, customer ids, amount range, sale/discount use or free text. GET /v1/orders.

search.description: Free-text search: order number, total amount, customer email or name, dates, statuses.

payment_method.description: Only orders paid with this method.

customer.description: Comma-separated customer ids (cus_...): only their orders.

order_amount_from.description: Only orders of at least this amount.

order_amount_to.description: Only orders of at most this amount.

has_sale.description: true: only orders where a sale promotion applied.

has_discount_code.description: true: only orders where a discount code applied.

has_automatic_discount.description: true: only orders where an automatic discount applied.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id (ord_..., not the #number shown in the dashboard): totals, customer, billing and shipping address, payment and fulfillment status, discounts, line items and tracking. GET /v1/orders/{id}.

order_id.description: Shoprocket order id, e.g. ord_646e1f65ebcad629610675. Find it with shoprocket_list_orders.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's payment status and/or fulfillment status (for example mark it shipped or paid). Shoprocket needs both values, so a value you leave out is read from the order first and kept. With send_email true Shoprocket EMAILS THE CUSTOMER an order update (optionally with custom_text); the default is no email. Cancelling can return the items to stock (release_stock). POST /v1/orders/{id}.

payment_status.description: New payment status. Omit to keep the current one.

fulfillment_status.description: New fulfillment status. Omit to keep the current one.

send_email.description: true = email the customer about this update. Default false: no email is sent.

custom_text.description: Extra text for the customer email. Only used when send_email is true.

release_stock.description: true = put the order's items back into stock. Only applies when fulfillment_status is cancelled.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with price, SKU, stock quantity, categories, images, variants (skus) and status. Search by text, filter by category slugs, product ids or slugs, and sort. GET /v1/products.

sort.description: product_order = store order (default), created = newest first.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id (prod_...): description, price, SKU, stock, dimensions, categories, media, variants (skus), add-ons. GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: WRITE: create a product in the store (visible to shoppers unless status is 0). A name and at least one category (name or slug) are required. Does not create duplicates by itself: calling twice creates two products. Variants and add-ons are not set by this tool. PUT /v1/products.

categories.description: Comma-separated categories the product belongs to (as Shoprocket's API takes them; see shoprocket_list_categories).

price.description: Price as an integer in the smallest currency unit (cents: 1999 = 19.99), as Shoprocket's API takes it. Check the reply.

weight.description: Weight, in the store's weight unit.

status.description: 1 = active (Shoprocket returns status "1" for live products), 0 = inactive.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: WRITE: change a product's fields (price, stock quantity, description, status...). Shoprocket requires the name on every update, so pass the current name to keep it. Only the fields you pass are sent. POST /v1/products/{id}.

name.description: Product name (required by Shoprocket on every update; pass the current one to keep it).

categories.description: Comma-separated categories for the product, in the same form as shoprocket_create_product. Shoprocket lists it as required but leaves it out of its update example: pass it if Shoprocket answers that categories are required.

price.description: Price as an integer in the smallest currency unit (cents: 1999 = 19.99), as Shoprocket's API takes it. Check the reply.

weight.description: Weight, in the store's weight unit.

status.description: 1 = active (Shoprocket returns status "1" for live products), 0 = inactive.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories with id, name and slug. GET /v1/categories.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: One category by id (cat_...); with expand_products also the products in it. GET /v1/categories/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_category
tools.title: Create category
tools.description: WRITE: create a product category (optionally assigning existing products). Calling twice with the same name may create a duplicate or be refused by Shoprocket. PUT /v1/categories.

slug.description: Unique slug. Default: the name, lowercase and hyphenated.

products.description: Comma-separated product ids (prod_...) to put in the category.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_category
tools.title: Update category
tools.description: WRITE: rename a category, change its slug, or set the products in it. Only the fields you pass are sent. POST /v1/categories/{id}.

products.description: Comma-separated product ids (prod_...) assigned to the category.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers with name, email, phone, company, tax number, country and marketing opt-in. GET /v1/customers.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id (cus_...). GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a customer record (it does not email the customer). marketing_subscribed records newsletter consent: set it to true only if the customer actually opted in. PUT /v1/customers.

marketing_subscribed.description: true only if the customer opted in to the newsletter.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change a customer's email, name, phone, company, tax number or newsletter consent. Only the fields you pass are sent. Set marketing_subscribed true only if the customer actually opted in. POST /v1/customers/{id}.

marketing_subscribed.description: true only if the customer opted in to the newsletter.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_discount_codes
tools.title: List discount codes
tools.description: List discount codes with type, value, what they apply to, usage limit and count, minimum order, dates and status. GET /v1/discount-codes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_discount_code
tools.title: Get discount code
tools.description: One discount code by id (ofr_...). GET /v1/discount-codes/{id}.

discount_code_id.description: Shoprocket discount code id, e.g. ofr_646dfea0b2880691674525.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_discount_code
tools.title: Create discount code
tools.description: WRITE: create a live discount code that shoppers can use at checkout and that reduces the store's revenue. Type fixed or percentage needs coupon_value; free_shipping does not. Use usage_limit and dates to bound it. Calling twice creates two codes. PUT /v1/discount-codes.

coupon_code.description: The code shoppers type. Default: Shoprocket generates a random one.

coupon_type.description: fixed = amount off, percentage = percent off, free_shipping.

coupon_value.description: Required for fixed and percentage. Shoprocket documents 'a positive integer in cents': for fixed 500 = 5.00; for percentage send the whole percent (10 = 10%) and check the reply.

description.description: What the code is for (shown in the dashboard).

coupon_applies_to.description: What it applies to. free_shipping allows only all_orders and all_orders_over.

coupon_applies_to_value.description: Required for multiple_products (comma-separated product ids) and categories (comma-separated category slugs).

usage_limit.description: Maximum number of uses in total.

minimum_order_value.description: Minimum order value in cents (as Shoprocket takes it); used with all_orders_over.

start_date.description: First valid day, yyyy-mm-dd. Required together with expire_date.

expire_date.description: Last valid day, yyyy-mm-dd. Required together with start_date.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_automatic_discounts
tools.title: List automatic discounts
tools.description: List automatic discounts (applied at checkout without a code) with type, value, conditions, dates and status. GET /v1/automatic-discounts.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_sales
tools.title: List sale promotions
tools.description: List sale promotions (price reductions on products) with type, value, what they apply to, dates and status. GET /v1/sale-promotions.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_shipping_methods
tools.title: List shipping methods
tools.description: List the store's shipping methods and rates. GET /v1/shippings.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_taxes
tools.title: List taxes
tools.description: List the store's tax rules. GET /v1/taxes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_zones
tools.title: List shipping zones
tools.description: List the store's shipping zones (the regions it ships to). GET /v1/zones.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the store's payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, manual...) and whether they are enabled. Gateway credentials are never returned. GET /v1/payment-methods.
